items.item_text: Board Certified or Eligible in OB/GYN
Previous experience preferred, but not required
If you’re looking to experience greater challenge and fulfillment in your career, UCan at UCLA Health.

Take on an important role within our world-class health system. Help drive the continued delivery of exceptional patient care. Take your career to the next level. UCan do all this and more at UCLA Health.

UCLA Health is seeking a compassionate and skilled OB/GYN Generalist to join our Westlake Village office, located in beautiful Ventura County. This practice offers an outpatient clinical site and access to a Level III Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU). You will collaborate with seven other generalists in a full-scope OB/GYN practice, maintaining an even balance between obstetrics and gynecology. Learn more about our Westlake Village OB/GYN practice,
Provide comprehensive care in both obstetrics and gynecology, addressing a diverse patient population’s needs.
Perform a variety of procedures, including routine prenatal care, labor and delivery, surgical interventions, and management of complex gynecological conditions.
Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals, including specialists in urogynecology.
Access state-of-the-art facilities, such as a thriving outpatient clinical site and a Level III NICU, ensuring the highest quality of care for your patients.

The Conejo Valley, including the cities of West Hills, Calabasas, Westlake Village and Thousand Oaks, are just a short drive northwest of Los Angeles. This area is nestled against the Santa Monica Mountains National Park with easy access to Malibu’s breathtaking beaches. This area offers great schools and neighborhoods with hundreds of miles of hiking and biking trails and outdoor recreational possibilities.
